newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FIVE SCHOOL-CHILDREN DIE IN S.AFRICAN BUS ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: FIVE SCHOOL-CHILDREN DIE IN S.AFRICAN BUS ACCIDENT.

text.p: Five children were killed and two seriously injured in a bus accident in South Africa's Free State region late on Friday night, police said on Saturday.

Police Senior Superintendent Johlene van der Merwe said 96 school pupils and four teachers from Parys were on their way home from a choir festival when the accident happened at 11 p.m. (2100 GMT) in the Glen district.

The bus driver apparently lost control of the vehicle while driving on a farm road and it overturned, ending up on its side on the bank of a river, she said in a statement. The two injured children were admitted to hospital.
